name: Kaison Voltaire
source:
Kaison Voltaire's father was a fencer. When he was 12, he got into an accident involving a fall which messed up many of his memories – in that hospital was where he first met Mikaela.
[spoiler]When he wa younger he had to kill his twin brother to save the Mysterious girl.[spoiler]
